LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_GizmoDiveDesc: Flood the ballast tanks and go under, which takes {SECONDS} seconds. Anyone watching as it goes down will follow it. Once out of sight it can be spotted only by someone near and looking, more easily on the move, and even then only an explosion can reach it. It cannot fire most of its guns or land anyone, and it runs down its air and charge, faster on the move.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_GizmoSurfaceDesc: Blow the tanks and come up, which takes {SECONDS} seconds. The boat can be seen from the moment it starts to rise. On the surface it takes on air and charges up again.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_GizmoStayDownDesc: When this is on, the boat stays under after its air and charge run out, instead of coming up. The crew then breathes stale air and gets steadily worse until they die. Once nobody aboard can work the boat, the order can no longer be changed and nothing aboard can bring it up.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_PhaseUnderSpotted: Under the water, and being followed
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_ToldStayDown: {VEHICLE} will stay under even when its air and charge run out.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_ToldComeUpWhenEmpty: {VEHICLE} will come up when its air and charge run out.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_Spotted: {VEHICLE} has been spotted under the water.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_Lost: The enemy has lost track of {VEHICLE}.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_EmptyStayingDown: {VEHICLE} is out of air and charge and staying down as ordered. The crew has started to breathe stale air.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseNotSurfaced: {VEHICLE} has to be fully on the surface first.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseCrew: {VEHICLE} does not have enough crew aboard to dive.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefusePart: The {PART} is too badly damaged to dive with. Mend it first.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseReserve: {VEHICLE} needs more air and charge first. Wait on the surface.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseShallow: The water here is too shallow for {VEHICLE} to dive. Every part of the hull has to be over deep water.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseLost: Nobody aboard {VEHICLE} can work it, so its orders cannot be changed and it cannot come up.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseLanding: {VEHICLE} has to surface before anyone can get out.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_LostText: Nobody aboard {VEHICLE} can work it any more, and its orders were to stay down. It will not come up by itself.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_UpEmpty: {VEHICLE} ran out of air and charge and had to surface.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_UpCrew: {VEHICLE} came up because nobody aboard can work it.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_UpPart: {VEHICLE} had to surface: its {PART} is too badly damaged to stay under.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_UpShallow: {VEHICLE} ran into shallow water and had to surface.
